info.name: Service Module — API Reference
info.description:
All Service-module API endpoints (Customer, Vendor app, Vendor AI) generated from Modules/Service routes + Documentation/service-customer-config-api.md, Documentation/service-vendor-api.md, Documentation/service-vendor-catalog-api.md.

Variables: base_url, token (vendor Bearer), module_id (Service module id), zone_id (JSON array), vendor_type (owner|employee).

request.description: Core customer config endpoint (App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1\ConfigController@configuration). When the Service addon is published the response carries a `service_module` object holding the booking business settings saved at admin/business-settings/service/booking. Only the `service_module` block is shown below; the full response also contains the base-system config keys.

response.name: Example (service_module block)
response.body:
{
  "service_module": {
    "instant_booking": true,
    "repeat_booking": false,
    "schedule_booking": true,
    "schedule_time_restriction_status": true,
    "schedule_time_restriction_value": 2,
    "schedule_time_restriction_unit": "hours",
    "bidding_system": true,
    "see_other_providers_offers": false,
    "post_validation_days": 7,
    "otp_for_complete_service": true,
    "complete_photo_evidence": false
  }
}

request.description: Returns Services.xlsx download (binary). For date_wise use from_date,to_date.
Current provider store-setup values (booking types / service location / serviceman permission) plus each field's *_editable global-gate flag.
Persist provided, gate-enabled fields. Partial updates supported; provider dropped when service_at_provider_place off; at least one of instant/schedule kept on.
multipart/form-data. image required (jpeg/png/jpg/gif, max 1024KB). Validation errors → 422.
